name: Rack 'n' Roll Delivery
overview: After being framed in a match that led to his girlfriend’s death, undefeated snooker champion Cheng Ye disappears from the spotlight and reinvents himself as a delivery driver under the alias Hei Ba. Ten years later, a chance encounter uncovers new clues suggesting her death was no accident. Determined to expose the truth, Cheng Ye returns to the high-stakes world of competitive billiards—unaware that the powerful forces behind the conspiracy are ready to silence him for good.
